SELECT MAX(T2.Consumption) ,  T1.Date 
FROM yearmonth AS T1 
JOIN customers AS T2 
ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE T1.Date LIKE '%/%/13' 
AND T2.Segment = 'SME';

SELECT MAX(T1.Consumption) , T2.Date 
FROM yearmonth AS T1 
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
JOIN customers AS T3 ON T3.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE T3.Segment = 'SME' AND YEAR(T2.Date) = 2013

SELECT MAX(C.Consumption) , DATE_FORMAT(YM.Date, '%Y-%m') 
FROM yearmonth YM 
JOIN customers C 
ON YM.CustomerID = C.CustomerID 
WHERE C.Segment = 'SME' AND YEAR(YM.Date) = 2013

SELECT MAX(Consumption) , YEARmonth.Date 
FROM yearmonth 
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
WHERE customers.Segment = 'SME' AND YEAR(yearmonth.Date) = 2013

SELECT MAX(T1.Consumption) ,  YEAR(T1.Date) ,  MONTH(T1.Date) 
FROM yearmonth AS T1 
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND YEAR(T1.Date) = 2013
